caption: The drawing depicts a single earthenware or stoneware jar with a wide mouth and a slightly flared rim. The jar is cylindrical in shape with a shoulder that curves inward before tapering out to a wider bottom. The upper portion of the jar has horizontal ridges encircling it, providing texture. On the side of the jar, there is an inscription that reads: “LIBERTY. FOR EV S.A.M.P.OY N. JERSY.” The inscription appears to be carved or impressed into the surface in uppercase letters, inside an uneven, jagged-edged area that appears slightly darker in tone. The jar is rendered in shades of light brown, beige, and gray, with darker shading to suggest depth and volume, and the inner surface is colored to convey the appearance of being hollow. The background is plain and a light tan color, without any additional objects or details. The artist’s signature “John Tarantino” is written in small letters near the bottom right of the image.
title: Crock
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
